note: Every case and every label in this file was written by a model (Fable 5.2) in plan 395-09. The owner did not review them. Every room state is synthetic: no real room, no real person, no real venture. A label is an opinion that rests on three repository sources: the serves_jtbd tag of a command (data/command-registry.json), the header of the command (description and teaching), and the routing table in references/methodology/problem-types.md. The label author saw the selector output for the 11 core sections with no goal before the labels were written; one label was changed after the first scorer run, in favour of the selector (sel-35: map-unknowns moved from wrong to acceptable, because the first label was stricter than the label rule).
label_rule: right = a command that runs on the case surface and that is a correct FIRST move for the job in this state: it serves the job (or, where no command lists the job, the section contract names it), and its own header fits what the section holds. acceptable = a defensible move that is not the best first move. wrong = a plausible mistake, named with its reason. A command in none of the three lists is not right; the scorer counts it as other. none_of_these = no shipped command that runs on the surface is a right first move.
